Name the day count and the goal (2,000 points of Astra Militarum for Palm Springs) and say he's still learning the list. Ask which unit he should paint next.
slots.uses: original audio, to-camera beat from the Road to Palm Springs serial
slots.batch_tip: Shoot this first in the same lighting setup as Slot C: set the key light and haze once, shoot the finished trooper as the cover shot, then film the to-camera line against the grey pile.
slots.why_it_should_work: Answers the audit's follow-through and growth findings: the to-camera story beat converts best on this account (16.2 follows per 1k on the 'My hobby journey' Reel), and the T-minus status format turns the 3-hours-a-week joke into a serial beat. Day count uses the challenge counter (59 days left), not the audit's 61. Cut to ~20s with the strongest shot first.

slots.title: Owner Picks My Next Unit (Kingslayer Games)
slots.hook: Second one: the store owner's pick, a boxed Astra Militarum kit, lands on the table under the store's overhead light, with the camera at eye level beside the box.
slots.on_screen_text: Kingslayer Games owner picks my next unit.
slots.caption_angle: Tag @Kingslayer Games and name the box and the brand by name in the caption and voiceover. Explain that he's handed the choice to the owner because he's still learning the list. slots.uses: original audio, store footage with the owner's pick
slots.batch_tip: Film the store table shot and the pick reveal in one visit; keep the slider on the table for a second take of the box in lit close-up to reuse in the hobby-desk tour later.
slots.why_it_should_work: Answers the audit's brand-proof and product-facing findings (zero brand tags in 28 days): it names the store and brand on screen and in the caption. Follows the store-crawl pattern of an owner picking a unit, and keeps it non-insider by explaining the pick without rules talk. Payoff in second one per the reach finding.

slots.title: Solar Auxilia Shoulder Pads Are Why I Need Therapy
slots.hook: Second one: the Solar Auxilia shoulder-pad arm held up to the lit slider shot, with the two-handed rifle dropping onto the table as the payoff.
slots.on_screen_text: Solar Auxilia shoulder pads. Two-handed rifles: still undefeated.
slots.caption_angle: Reply to the viewer's comment: he's struggling with the shoulder pads on the Solar Auxilia rifle section too. Ask viewers which kit beat them, and say which build they'd want him to try next.

slots.batch_tip: Shoot after Slot A while the lights are still set; use the same slider and key light, with the reaction shot done straight after a take of the rifle dropping.

audit.headline: Reach is holding, but nothing product-facing has gone out in four weeks, and none of last week's planned slate appears to have posted.

findings.evidence: Of 17 labelled posts in 28 days, 9 were meme, 3 craft, 2 story, 3 other and 0 product-facing, against a target of about 50% product-facing.
findings.action: Make the planned "What's actually on my hobby desk" tour this week's second post, and name each product in it.

findings.evidence: No product-facing posts in 4 weeks and 0 posts tagging a brand or store, so nothing a brand could judge.
findings.action: Tag every brand whose product appears in the hobby-desk tour, and say each product by name in the voiceover.

findings.evidence: posted_since is empty, so Slot A (T-minus 61 Commissar Inspection), Slot B (Battleforce store crawl) and Slot C (Dorn turret) do not appear to have gone out; the last post was 4 days ago.
findings.action: Carry Slot A forward as this week's to-camera episode. Drop Slot B and C unless the three planned posts are already done.

findings.evidence: The 28-day median is 4,550 views, down from 6,795 in the previous window, with 4 breakout, 2 above, 4 baseline and 5 under-performing posts.
findings.action: Put the payoff in second one on every post this week. The 11-11 unpainted-parts Reel (1,025 views, 26.7s, 0.2x median) is the one to recut next week: 10 to 15s, most unpainted model on screen first.

findings.evidence: 3 posts in the last 7 days and 4.2 a week over 28 days, against a target of 1 to 3.
Median length is 15.2s. Only 2 of 15 videos ran over 45s, and those had a median of 10,481 views, the highest bucket, while up to 30s had 4,545.
Likes plus comments run at 6.3% of views, against 6.7% in the previous 4 weeks, with a median of 8 comments a post.

goals: Post Slot A, "T-minus 61: The Commissar Inspection", as a to-camera Road to Palm Springs episode of about 20s, with the finished lit Guardsman on screen in second one, by Sunday. It did not go out last week.

audit.guidance: Favour self-directed jokes about his own minis, his Guard army or his painting time, at 15s or under, with the payoff visible in second one; keep the to-camera episode near 20s with the strongest shot first. Avoid lore, price news, rules-dependent bits and long build logs that open on craft. Keep the week to three new posts: the planned bank meme, the hobby-desk tour and Slot A.

posts.caption: Funny noticing all of the parts I left unpainted now that I look at it under a camera 😬😬 #warhammer40k #warhammer #hobby #40k #paintingwarhammer

posts.worked: It's about his own unpainted minis, a relatable self-joke, and a viewer wrote a dialogue-style line about his painting (the clown comment), which is the comment-writing behavior the kaiju format aims for.
posts.didnt: At 26.7s with a caption that spells out the joke, it runs long for a meme; the non-original audio and a likely slow opener are probable reasons for only 1,025 views, but check the opener.
posts.next_time: Cut to 10–15s, open on the most obviously unpainted model under the camera in second one, and let the comments do the rest.

posts.caption: This Warhound has seen better days… Also I hope they don’t make it $300 but I bet it’ll be worse. #warhammer40k #warhammer #hobby #40k #paintingwarhammer
posts.label: meme
posts.worked: Original audio and a joke about his own damaged Warhound give it a personal angle, and a viewer picked it up as a box-speculation bit, which shows some engagement.
posts.didnt: The price joke needs knowledge of a product announcement, so it reads as insider news and fails the non-player test; at 21.8s it also runs long for a meme.
posts.next_time: Drop the price talk, put the battle damage on screen in second one with a one-line joke about his Warhound, and keep it under 15s.

patterns: Shorter, self-directed jokes won: the top three (7.3s, 8.0s, 15.2s) are all about him or his hobby life and reached 15.6x to 36.2x the window median of 6,795; all of the weakest three were 13s or longer and either insider lore/product talk or generic.

Insider framing failed when it wasn't a visible joke: the Alpha Legion meme (0.1x) and the Warhound price bit (0.3x) both needed prior knowledge, matching the brief's warning that insider-only posts flop for non-players.
The window gives no follow counts for most posts, so these reads are about reach and comments only; use the next week's follows-per-1k to test whether the self-joke format converts, not just reaches.
